episodes.title: Why I Left the Church After Growing Up Pentecostal
episodes.description:
Growing up, I got grounded from church. Yes, you heard that right.

I was raised in the UPCI and was in church multiple times a week. I spent more time there than in the house I lived in. Here’s what it was really like inside, and why I left.

If God is everywhere, why are we stuck in this ugly ass building together doing all this nonsense?

episodes.title: Raised in a Church Cult. Now a Magical Menace. (Channel Intro)
episodes.description:
I grew up in a church cult. I got free. Now I'm telling the truth about it.

I'm here to help you deconstruct what doesn't work, rebuild from what's real, and reclaim your power. If you're ready to question everything, laugh a little, and return to your true self, you're in the right place.
